It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) as input and outputs report (array).

root_description_as_composed: Uses a records array and a personal-data report to identify remaining quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely single out records after direct personal data is removed.

name: Pseudonymisation Plan Builder
description: Builds a pseudonymisation plan from the personal-data and quasi-identifier reports. The plan names direct fields to tokenise and quasi-identifier fields to preserve for re-identification checks, takes personal_report (array) and quasi_report (array) as input and outputs plan (object).
root_description: Combines personal-data and quasi-identifier reports into a plan naming direct fields to tokenise and quasi-identifier fields to preserve for re-identification checks.
root_description_as_composed: Combines personal-data and quasi-identifier reports into a plan naming direct fields to tokenise and quasi-identifier fields to preserve for re-identification checks.

name: Apply Pseudonymisation Plan
description: Applies a pseudonymisation plan to table records and returns pseudonymised table records. Detected direct-identifier values are replaced with reversible pseudonyms, while non-target fields are preserved, takes records (array) and plan (object) as input and outputs pseudonymised_records (array).
root_description: Apply a pseudonymisation plan to table records, replacing direct identifiers with reversible pseudonyms while preserving all other fields.
root_description_as_composed: Apply a pseudonymisation plan to table records, replacing direct identifiers with reversible pseudonyms while preserving all other fields.

name: Equivalence Class Group Builder
description: Groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) as input and outputs groups (array).
root_description: From a records array and a quasi_report array, it outputs groups containing pseudonymised records with identical quasi-identifier patterns.
root_description_as_composed: From a records array and a quasi_report array, it outputs groups containing pseudonymised records with identical quasi-identifier patterns.

name: k-Anonymity Group Size Report
description: Compares equivalence-class sizes with a minimum group-size threshold and returns a k-anonymity report. The report lists class sizes, the minimum k achieved, and classes that do not meet the threshold, takes groups (array) and threshold (number) as input and outputs report (object).
root_description: Returns a k-anonymity report from group counts and a threshold, listing all class sizes, the minimum k, and classes below threshold.
root_description_as_composed: Returns a k-anonymity report from group counts and a threshold, listing all class sizes, the minimum k, and classes below threshold.

name: Sensitive Group Diversity Report
description: Measures distinct sensitive-attribute values inside each equivalence class using the column mapping and threshold. It returns an l-diversity report with group-level diversity scores and classes that fail the threshold, takes groups (array), column_mapping (object) and threshold (number) as input and outputs report (object).
root_description: Evaluates preformed groups for distinct sensitive-attribute values against a numeric threshold and returns per-group diversity scores plus classes that fail it.
root_description_as_composed: Evaluates preformed groups for distinct sensitive-attribute values against a numeric threshold and returns per-group diversity scores plus classes that fail it.

name: Combined Re-Identification Risk Score
description: Combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) and groups (array) as input and outputs score (number).
root_description: Combines k-anonymity, l-diversity and equivalence-class evidence into one numeric re-identification risk score.
root_description_as_composed: Combines k-anonymity, l-diversity and equivalence-class evidence into one numeric re-identification risk score.

name: Dataset Question to Search Keywords
description: Translates a natural-language dataset question into keyword records for catalogue search. It expands each requested topic into searchable terms and facets, takes question (string) as input and outputs keywords (array).
root_description: Converts a natural-language dataset question into an expanded list of search keywords and facet terms for catalogue discovery.
root_description_as_composed: Converts a natural-language dataset question into an expanded list of search keywords and facet terms for catalogue discovery.

name: Ranked Dataset Identifier Retrieval
description: Searches a dataset retrieval index using keyword records and returns ranked dataset identifiers. It applies the recommendation limit to the candidate list, takes keywords (array), index (object) and limit (number) as input and outputs candidates (array).
root_description: Searches a dataset index with supplied keywords and a limit, returning ranked matching dataset identifiers.
root_description_as_composed: Searches a dataset index with supplied keywords and a limit, returning ranked matching dataset identifiers.

name: Bounded Dataset Row Sample
description: Materializes a bounded row sample from a dataset for profiling. It uses the supplied threshold as the maximum number of rows to return, takes dataset (object) and row_limit (number) as input and outputs sample_rows (array).
root_description: Reads a dataset and returns at most the allowed number of rows as a sample array for quick profiling.
root_description_as_composed: Reads a dataset and returns at most the allowed number of rows as a sample array for quick profiling.

name: Dataset Metadata Profile Builder
description: Builds a metadata profile for a dataset from its catalogue entry. It records available column names, column types, row counts, and provenance fields, takes dataset (object) as input and outputs profile (object).
root_description: Summarises a dataset from its catalogue entry into a profile containing column names, column types, row count, and provenance information.
root_description_as_composed: Summarises a dataset from its catalogue entry into a profile containing column names, column types, row count, and provenance information.

name: Table Sample Column Profile
description: Builds a column-level profile from table records. It summarizes observed column names, inferred types, and row counts for catalogue comparison, takes sample_rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object).
root_description: Creates a column-level profile from sampled table records, reporting observed columns, inferred types, and sample row count.
root_description_as_composed: Creates a column-level profile from sampled table records, reporting observed columns, inferred types, and sample row count.

name: Dataset Profile Card Generator
description: Composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) as input and outputs summary (string).
root_description: Turns a dataset profile into a plain-text dataset card describing size, key columns, and profile coverage.
root_description_as_composed: Turns a dataset profile into a plain-text dataset card describing size, key columns, and profile coverage.

name: Dataset Profile Schema Diff
description: Compares two dataset profiles and returns a schema validation report. It flags missing, extra, and type-mismatched columns, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs schema_diff (array).
root_description: Compares two dataset column profiles and returns a schema validation report listing missing, extra, and type-mismatched columns.
root_description_as_composed: Compares two dataset column profiles and returns a schema validation report listing missing, extra, and type-mismatched columns.

name: Rank Candidates Against Dataset Profile
description: Reranks candidate dataset identifiers against a reference dataset profile. It puts candidates with more compatible schema and coverage characteristics first, takes candidates (array) and reference_profile (object) as input and outputs ranked_candidates (array).
root_description: Reranks candidate dataset identifiers so those whose schema and coverage best match a reference dataset profile appear first.
root_description_as_composed: Reranks candidate dataset identifiers so those whose schema and coverage best match a reference dataset profile appear first.

name: Plain Text Chunk Splitter
description: Splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array).
root_description: Splits a plain-text document into ordered chunks whose lengths do not exceed a specified maximum size.
root_description_as_composed: Splits a plain-text document into ordered chunks whose lengths do not exceed a specified maximum size.

name: Text Chunk Language Detection
description: Detects the written language of each text chunk. Returns language identification records with language codes and confidence scores, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs language_records (array).
root_description: Detects the written language of each text chunk and returns language records containing language codes and confidence scores.
root_description_as_composed: Detects the written language of each text chunk and returns language records containing language codes and confidence scores.

name: Text Chunks Requiring Translation
description: Filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array), language_records (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array).
root_description: Returns the subset of provided text chunks whose language differs from the requested translation target.
root_description_as_composed: Returns the subset of provided text chunks whose language differs from the requested translation target.

name: Translate Text Chunks by Target Language
description: Translates each source text chunk into the requested target language, takes chunks (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs translated_chunks (array).
root_description: Translates each input text chunk into the requested target language and returns the translated chunks as an array.
root_description_as_composed: Translates each input text chunk into the requested target language and returns the translated chunks as an array.

name: Translated Chunk Cleanup
description: Cleans translated chunks by normalizing whitespace, preserving placeholders, and repairing formatting with reference to the original source chunks, takes translated_chunks (array) and source_chunks (array) as input and outputs cleaned_translated_chunks (array).
root_description: Cleans translated chunks against their source chunks and returns tidied translated chunks with placeholders and formatting kept intact.
root_description_as_composed: Cleans translated chunks against their source chunks and returns tidied translated chunks with placeholders and formatting kept intact.

name: Bilingual Segment Alignment Confidence
description: Aligns source and translated text chunks by length, order, and content cues, returning segment pairs with confidence scores, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and align_threshold (number) as input and outputs segment_alignment (array).
root_description: Matches source and translated text chunks into confident segment pairs using length, order, and content cues.
root_description_as_composed: Matches source and translated text chunks into confident segment pairs using length, order, and content cues.

name: Segment Alignment Acceptance Validator
description: Reviews segment alignments against a quality threshold and returns a validation report plus the alignments that pass, takes translated_chunks (array), segment_alignment (array) and accept_threshold (number) as input and outputs validation_report (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array).
root_description: It checks translated segment alignments against a supplied quality threshold and returns a validation report alongside only the alignments that meet the threshold.
root_description_as_composed: It checks translated segment alignments against a supplied quality threshold and returns a validation report alongside only the alignments that meet the threshold.

name: Assemble Approved Translation Text
description: Reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array) as input and outputs translated_text (string).
root_description: Combines editor-approved translated chunks into one full translated text, substituting original source chunks where no approved translation is matched.
root_description_as_composed: Combines editor-approved translated chunks into one full translated text, substituting original source chunks where no approved translation is matched.

name: Ordered Date-Value Series Builder
description: Builds an ordered economic indicator or price time series from table rows. It uses the date and value columns named in the column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs series (array).
root_description: Builds an ordered date-value series from table rows by sorting rows on the mapped date column and pairing each date with its mapped value.
root_description_as_composed: Builds an ordered date-value series from table rows by sorting rows on the mapped date column and pairing each date with its mapped value.

name: Level Series Percentage Returns
description: Converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array).
root_description: Transforms a level time-series array into a time-series array of period-over-period percentage returns at the specified granularity.
root_description_as_composed: Transforms a level time-series array into a time-series array of period-over-period percentage returns at the specified granularity.

name: Seasonal Indicator Profile Estimator
description: Estimates seasonal patterns in an economic indicator time series for the supplied seasonal period length. It returns a seasonality profile describing seasonal indices by period, takes series (array) and period_length (number) as input and outputs profile (object).
root_description: Estimates a seasonality profile of average seasonal indices for each period from a time-series array and seasonal cycle length.
root_description_as_composed: Estimates a seasonality profile of average seasonal indices for each period from a time-series array and seasonal cycle length.

name: Seasonally Adjust Economic Indicator
description: Removes seasonal effects from an economic indicator time series using a seasonality profile. It returns a seasonally adjusted time series, takes series (array) and profile (object) as input and outputs adjusted_series (array).
root_description: Removes seasonal effects from an economic indicator time series using a seasonality profile and returns a seasonally adjusted series.
root_description_as_composed: Removes seasonal effects from an economic indicator time series using a seasonality profile and returns a seasonally adjusted series.

name: Rolling Realized Volatility Series
description: Computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array).
root_description: Given an array of returns and a window size, computes and returns an array of rolling realized volatility values over successive windows.
root_description_as_composed: Given an array of returns and a window size, computes and returns an array of rolling realized volatility values over successive windows.

name: Historical Loss Estimate
description: Estimates historical value at risk from a return series at the supplied confidence level and forecast horizon. It returns a scalar risk measure, takes returns (array), confidence (number) and horizon (number) as input and outputs var (number).
root_description: It takes a return series, confidence percentage, and forecast horizon, and returns a single scalar historical loss estimate.
root_description_as_composed: It takes a return series, confidence percentage, and forecast horizon, and returns a single scalar historical loss estimate.

name: Budget Actual Period Variance Report
description: Compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).
root_description: Takes fiscal-period budget and actual records with field mappings and returns a period-by-period report of absolute and percentage variances.
root_description_as_composed: Takes fiscal-period budget and actual records with field mappings and returns a period-by-period report of absolute and percentage variances.

name: Period Variance Safety Check
description: Checks period variances in the comparison report against the supplied absolute limit. It returns a safety flag that is true when every period variance is within the limit, takes comparison (object) and limit (number) as input and outputs safe (boolean).
root_description: It returns a safety flag indicating whether every period variance in a comparison report stays within the supplied absolute limit.
root_description_as_composed: It returns a safety flag indicating whether every period variance in a comparison report stays within the supplied absolute limit.

name: Extract Patient-Level Clinical Records
description: Filters clinical table rows to patient-level records and keeps only the columns named in the column mapping. Rows without a patient identifier are excluded, takes table_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs patient_records (array).
root_description: Extracts patient-level clinical rows that have a patient identifier and keeps only the columns listed in the column mapping, returning an array of patient records.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts patient-level clinical rows that have a patient identifier and keeps only the columns listed in the column mapping, returning an array of patient records.

name: Patients Enrolled Between Dates
description: Keeps patient records whose enrollment date is between the start and end dates. Dates are returned as normalized date strings, takes patient_records (array), start_date (string) and end_date (string) as input and outputs patient_records (array).
root_description: This AP filters a patient_records array to keep only patients whose enrollment date falls between a start_date and end_date, returning the patient records with normalized date strings.
root_description_as_composed: This AP filters a patient_records array to keep only patients whose enrollment date falls between a start_date and end_date, returning the patient records with normalized date strings.

name: Medical Code Descendant Expansion
description: Expands a base medical code set to descendant codes using parent-child vocabulary triples. It returns the original codes and any reachable descendants, takes base_code_set (array) and vocabulary_triples (array) as input and outputs expanded_code_set (array).
root_description: Expands a starting medical code list to include all codes reachable through parent-child vocabulary relationships.
root_description_as_composed: Expands a starting medical code list to include all codes reachable through parent-child vocabulary relationships.

name: Diagnosis Text to Codes
description: Assigns standard codes to diagnosis text fields using terms and synonyms from the supplied medical code set. It appends coded diagnosis fields without removing source text, takes patient_records (array) and code_set (array) as input and outputs coded_patient_records (array).
root_description: Adds standard medical codes to free-text diagnosis fields by matching terms and synonyms from a supplied code set, preserving the original diagnosis text and returning coded patient records.
root_description_as_composed: Adds standard medical codes to free-text diagnosis fields by matching terms and synonyms from a supplied code set, preserving the original diagnosis text and returning coded patient records.

name: Diagnosis Code Patient Filter
description: Keeps coded patient records containing at least one diagnosis code in the target medical code set. Records with no matching code are removed, takes coded_patient_records (array) and target_code_set (array) as input and outputs coded_patient_records (array).
root_description: Starting with coded patient records and a target medical code set, it keeps only the records containing at least one matching diagnosis code and returns the filtered record set.
root_description_as_composed: Starting with coded patient records and a target medical code set, it keeps only the records containing at least one matching diagnosis code and returns the filtered record set.

name: Coded Patient Survival Record Builder
description: Builds survival records from coded patient records by extracting patient identifier, follow-up time, and event indicator columns named in the column mapping. Records with missing time or event values are excluded, takes coded_patient_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs survival_records (array).
root_description: Builds survival-ready records by selecting mapped patient ID, follow-up time, and event columns from coded patient records and excluding rows with missing time or event values.
root_description_as_composed: Builds survival-ready records by selecting mapped patient ID, follow-up time, and event columns from coded patient records and excluding rows with missing time or event values.

name: Kaplan-Meier Survival Curve Points
description: Estimates Kaplan-Meier survival curve points from survival records and a minimum event-group size threshold. The output contains time points, survival probability, events, and number at risk, takes survival_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs survival_curve (array).
root_description: Computes survival curve time points with survival probabilities, event counts, and number at risk from survival records using a minimum group-size threshold.
root_description_as_composed: Computes survival curve time points with survival probabilities, event counts, and number at risk from survival records using a minimum group-size threshold.

name: Cox Survival Hazard Model Fit
description: Fits a Cox proportional hazards model to survival records using covariates named in the column mapping. The output is a regression fit containing hazard ratios and model diagnostics, takes survival_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs regression_fit (object).
root_description: Fits a Cox proportional hazards model from survival records and a column mapping, returning hazard ratios and model diagnostics.
root_description_as_composed: Fits a Cox proportional hazards model from survival records and a column mapping, returning hazard ratios and model diagnostics.

name: Mapped Survey Response Extractor
description: Extracts survey response rows from table records and keeps only the columns named in the mapping. Rows without a response identifier are excluded, takes table_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_response_records (array).
root_description: Extracts valid survey response rows from table records and returns them with only the columns named in the mapping.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts valid survey response rows from table records and returns them with only the columns named in the mapping.

name: Survey Job Text Chunks
description: Extracts free-text job titles, employer names, and duty descriptions from survey response records into text chunks. Each chunk keeps a response identifier, takes survey_response_records (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array).
root_description: It reads survey response records and returns response-ID-tagged text chunks containing the free-text job titles, employer names, and duty descriptions found in the responses.
root_description_as_composed: It reads survey response records and returns response-ID-tagged text chunks containing the free-text job titles, employer names, and duty descriptions found in the responses.

name: Occupational Text Chunk Cleaner
description: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations. It preserves chunk and response identifiers, takes text_chunks (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array).
root_description: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations while preserving chunk and response identifiers.
root_description_as_composed: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations while preserving chunk and response identifiers.

name: ISCO Occupation Coding Records
description: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array).
root_description: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns occupation coding records with candidate occupation codes and confidence scores.
root_description_as_composed: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns occupation coding records with candidate occupation codes and confidence scores.

name: Single ISCO Occupation Coding
description: Assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array), survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array).
root_description: Selects the highest-confidence occupation candidate above a threshold for each survey response and returns the response fields with the assigned ISCO code.
root_description_as_composed: Selects the highest-confidence occupation candidate above a threshold for each survey response and returns the response fields with the assigned ISCO code.

name: Occupation Survey Weight Plan
description: Builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).
root_description: Creates per-response survey weights from coded occupation records and occupation group mappings so the observed occupation mix matches target population shares.
root_description_as_composed: Creates per-response survey weights from coded occupation records and occupation group mappings so the observed occupation mix matches target population shares.

name: Occupation Weighted Survey Records
description: Applies the weight plan to coded response records and adds a numeric weight field to each output record. It returns weighted survey records without changing the underlying response values, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and survey_weight_plan (object) as input and outputs weighted_survey_records (array).
root_description: Applies an occupation weight plan to coded survey response records, adding a numeric weight field to each record and returning the weighted records without altering the original responses.
root_description_as_composed: Applies an occupation weight plan to coded survey response records, adding a numeric weight field to each record and returning the weighted records without altering the original responses.

name: Weighted Survey Crosstab
description: Builds a cross-tabulation table from weighted survey records using the row and column variables named in the column mapping. It returns result rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages, takes weighted_survey_records (array) and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs result_rows (array).
root_description: Builds a cross-tabulation table from weighted survey records and a column mapping, returning rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages.
root_description_as_composed: Builds a cross-tabulation table from weighted survey records and a column mapping, returning rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages.

name: Natural Language Safe SQL Execution
description: Takes nl (string) and is_safe (boolean) and produces result (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: translates a natural-language string into a safe SQL query, takes nl (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) from step 1 and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array).
root_description: Converts a natural-language question into safe SQL and returns the matching dataset rows.
root_description_as_composed: Converts a plain-language request into a safe SQL query.

name: Student Graph Performance Profile
description: Takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) and produces performance_profile (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 2: aggregates a student's assessment result rows into a profile with scores by topic, accuracy, and recent trend. Returns the profile without recommending study material, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs performance_profile (object).
root_description: Runs a supplied graph query plan over assessment graph triples and aggregates the returned rows into one student's performance profile with scores by topic, accuracy, and recent trend.
root_description_as_composed: Executes a supplied graph query plan against graph triples and returns the matching result rows.

name: Plain-Language Graph Query Summary
description: Takes graph_query_plan (object), graph_triples (array) and query (string) and produces summary (string) in 3 steps. Step 1: runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 2: aggregates numeric columns in a result-row array into compact summary rows and returns the aggregate rows, takes rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs rows (array). Step 3: summarises a result-row array in plain language using the originating SQL query as context and returns a result summary, takes rows (array) from step 2 and query (string) as input and outputs summary (string).
root_description: Runs a graph query plan over triples, aggregates numeric result columns into compact rows, and returns a plain-language summary of the query results using the original SQL as context.
root_description_as_composed: Executes a supplied graph query plan against graph triples and returns the matching result rows.

name: Scanned Page Summary
description: Takes page_images (array) and produces summary (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: runs OCR on each page image and returns recognized page text as ordered text chunks, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array). Step 2: summarizes an array of text chunks into a shorter plain-text summary, takes chunks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs summary (string).
root_description: Converts an array of page images into a concise plain-text summary of the recognized page content.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts readable text from each supplied page image and returns it as page-ordered text chunks.

name: Speaker Transcript Alignment
description: Takes audio_file (string), silence_threshold (number), assignments (array) and transcripts (array) and produces aligned_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: splits an audio file into speech segments using silence and energy thresholds. Returns segment records with identifiers, start times, and end times, takes audio_file (string) and silence_threshold (number) as input and outputs segments (array). Step 2: resolves overlapping speaker assignments into single-speaker time slices using the original segment timing. Returns refined speaker assignment records without changing speaker identifiers, takes segments (array) from step 1 and assignments (array) as input and outputs refined_assignments (array). Step 3: merges transcript records with speaker assignment records by segment identifier and time overlap. Returns speaker transcript records containing speaker, text, timing, and confidence, takes transcripts (array) and assignments (array) from step 2 as input and outputs aligned_records (array).
root_description: Generates speaker-labelled transcript records with timings and confidence from audio, silence settings, speaker tags, and text fragments.
root_description_as_composed: Splits an audio file into speech segment records with identifiers, start times, and end times by applying silence and energy thresholds.

name: Speaker Overlap Refinement from Audio
description: Takes audio_file (string), silence_threshold (number) and assignments (array) and produces refined_assignments (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: splits an audio file into speech segments using silence and energy thresholds. Returns segment records with identifiers, start times, and end times, takes audio_file (string) and silence_threshold (number) as input and outputs segments (array). Step 2: resolves overlapping speaker assignments into single-speaker time slices using the original segment timing. Returns refined speaker assignment records without changing speaker identifiers, takes segments (array) from step 1 and assignments (array) as input and outputs refined_assignments (array).
root_description: Given an audio file and raw speaker assignments, it returns non-overlapping speaker time slices for detected speech while keeping speaker identifiers unchanged.
root_description_as_composed: Splits an audio file into speech segment records with identifiers, start times, and end times by applying silence and energy thresholds.

name: Speaker Transcript Alignment
description: Takes segments (array), assignments (array) and transcripts (array) and produces aligned_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: resolves overlapping speaker assignments into single-speaker time slices using the original segment timing. Returns refined speaker assignment records without changing speaker identifiers, takes segments (array) and assignments (array) as input and outputs refined_assignments (array). Step 2: merges transcript records with speaker assignment records by segment identifier and time overlap. Returns speaker transcript records containing speaker, text, timing, and confidence, takes transcripts (array) and assignments (array) from step 1 as input and outputs aligned_records (array).
root_description: Resolves overlapping speaker assignments over segments and merges them with transcripts to produce aligned speaker transcript records with timing and confidence.
root_description_as_composed: Refines timed speaker assignment records into single-speaker slices using the original segment timing while keeping speaker identifiers unchanged.

name: Time Series Dashboard Assembler
description: Takes series (array), metric (string), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces dashboard (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 1, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array). Step 3: arranges a chart collection into a dashboard specification with panels and titles, takes chart_collection (array) from step 2 as input and outputs dashboard (object).
root_description: Creates a titled dashboard specification by turning a time series and metric into a panel and arranging it with two supplied charts.
root_description_as_composed: Creates a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the plotted metric.

name: Extract Tables From Page Images
description: Takes page_images (array) and text_chunks (array) and produces table_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: segments page images into layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs layout_blocks (array). Step 2: selects table layout blocks and converts them into bounding table regions ready for cell extraction, takes layout_blocks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs table_regions (array). Step 3: extracts headers and cell values from table regions using the corresponding OCR text, takes table_regions (array) from step 2 and text_chunks (array) as input and outputs table_records (array).
root_description: Segments page images into layout blocks, isolates table regions, and uses the associated OCR text to return header-and-cell table records.
root_description_as_composed: Segments an array of page images into typed layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables.

name: Table Region Detection
description: Takes page_images (array) and produces table_regions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: segments page images into layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs layout_blocks (array). Step 2: selects table layout blocks and converts them into bounding table regions ready for cell extraction, takes layout_blocks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs table_regions (array).
root_description: It converts page images into layout blocks and returns bounding regions for the table blocks.
root_description_as_composed: Segments an array of page images into typed layout blocks such as paragraphs, headings, figures, and tables.

name: Table Records from Blocks and Text
description: Takes layout_blocks (array) and text_chunks (array) and produces table_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: selects table layout blocks and converts them into bounding table regions ready for cell extraction, takes layout_blocks (array) as input and outputs table_regions (array). Step 2: extracts headers and cell values from table regions using the corresponding OCR text, takes table_regions (array) from step 1 and text_chunks (array) as input and outputs table_records (array).
root_description: Converts layout blocks and OCR text chunks into structured table records by isolating table areas and extracting their headers and cell values.
root_description_as_composed: The AP takes layout_blocks, keeps the table blocks, and outputs bounding table_regions ready for cell extraction.

name: Weather Forecast Accuracy Scorer
description: Takes readings (array), variable (string) and forecast (array) and produces accuracy (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts weather reading records for a selected variable into an ordered numeric time series, takes readings (array) and variable (string) as input and outputs series (array). Step 2: scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and forecast (array) as input and outputs accuracy (number).
root_description: Convert selected weather observations into a time series and score a forecast against the recent observed tail.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts the numeric values for one chosen variable from weather reading records and returns them as an ordered time series.

name: Weather Target Comparison Chart Bundle
description: Takes readings (array), period_granularity (string), summary_metric (string), target_summary (array), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces chart_collection (array) in 4 steps. Step 1: groups weather readings by time period and computes the chosen summary metric, takes readings (array), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) as input and outputs summary (array). Step 2: compares baseline and target period summaries and returns period-by-period differences, takes baseline_summary (array) from step 1 and target_summary (array) as input and outputs report (object). Step 3: turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) from step 2 as input and outputs chart (object). Step 4: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 3, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).
root_description: Groups weather readings by period, compares them with a target period set, creates a comparison chart, and collects it with two provided charts into a dashboard-ready chart array.
root_description_as_composed: Summarizes weather readings into values for chosen time periods such as daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly aggregates.

name: Duplicate Candidate Group Builder
description: Takes profile (object) and rows (array) and produces duplicate_groups (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: selects candidate duplicate-key columns and matching options from a dataset profile. Returns a duplicate-key specification without grouping rows, takes profile (object) as input and outputs key_spec (object). Step 2: groups table rows into duplicate candidate clusters using a duplicate-key specification. Returns duplicate groups without deleting rows, takes rows (array) and key_spec (object) from step 1 as input and outputs duplicate_groups (array).
root_description: The AP infers likely duplicate-matching fields from a dataset profile and groups the supplied rows into candidate duplicate clusters.
root_description_as_composed: Builds a duplicate-key specification with candidate columns and matching tolerances from a dataset profile, without grouping or removing rows.

name: Assign Addresses to Polygons
description: Takes address_list (array) and polygons (array) and produces polygons (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts a list of textual addresses into point geometries, takes address_list (array) as input and outputs points (array). Step 2: assigns point geometries to containing polygons and returns polygons with joined point attributes, takes points (array) from step 1 and polygons (array) as input and outputs polygons (array).
root_description: Converts textual addresses to locations and returns polygons enriched with the attributes of the address records that fall inside them.
root_description_as_composed: Converts an array of textual addresses into an array of point geometries representing their locations.

name: Identify Chunks Needing Translation
description: Takes segments (array), chunks (array) and target_language (string) and produces chunks_to_translate (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: detects the spoken language for each audio segment. Returns language identification records with ISO language codes and confidence scores, takes segments (array) as input and outputs language_records (array). Step 2: filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array), language_records (array) from step 1 and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array).
root_description: Detects the spoken language of each audio segment and returns only the paired text chunks that are not already in the target language.
root_description_as_composed: Identifies the spoken language of each provided audio segment and returns language records with ISO codes and confidence scores.

name: Optimized SQL Query Explainer
description: Takes query (string) and schema (string) and produces explanation (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: rewrites an SQL query for better performance using the database schema and returns the optimized query, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: produces a plain-language explanation of an SQL query given the target schema, takes query (string) from step 1 and schema (string) as input and outputs explanation (string).
root_description: Rewrites a supplied SQL query for better performance using its schema and then explains the optimized query in plain language.
root_description_as_composed: Rewrites a supplied SQL query, using its database schema, into a faster query that should return the same results.

name: Weather Reading Trend and Seasonality
description: Takes readings (array), variable (string) and season_length (number) and produces trend (array) and seasonality (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts weather reading records for a selected variable into an ordered numeric time series, takes readings (array) and variable (string) as input and outputs series (array). Step 2: decomposes a time series into a trend component and a seasonal profile for a fixed seasonal period, takes series (array) from step 1 and season_length (number) as input and outputs trend (array) and seasonality (object).
root_description: It takes weather reading records for a selected measure and separates the underlying trend from a seasonal profile for a fixed cycle length.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts the numeric values for one chosen variable from weather reading records and returns them as an ordered time series.

name: Cross-source Entity Candidate Matching
description: Takes left_profile (object), right_profile (object), column_mapping (object), left_entities (array) and right_entities (array) and produces candidate_pairs (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: compares two dataset profiles and reports columns whose value domains are incompatible. Returns the comparison report without rewriting the datasets, takes left_profile (object) and right_profile (object) as input and outputs report (array). Step 2: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 3: generates candidate cross-source matches between two entity record sets using mapped attributes. It returns candidate pairs before clustering, takes left_entities (array), right_entities (array) and value_mapping (object) from step 2 as input and outputs candidate_pairs (array).
root_description: Compares two dataset profiles, suggests value translations for mapped fields, and returns candidate cross-source record pairs before grouping.
root_description_as_composed: Compares two dataset profiles and returns a report of columns whose value domains are incompatible.

name: Annotated Volatility Chart
description: Takes returns (array), window (number), target_granularity (string), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 4 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 3: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 2 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 4: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 3 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Creates an annotated line chart from a return series by computing rolling volatility, resampling the volatility to a target granularity, and adding a note.
root_description_as_composed: Given an array of returns and a window size, computes and returns an array of rolling realized volatility values over successive windows.

name: Resampled Rolling Volatility
description: Takes returns (array), window (number) and target_granularity (string) and produces resampled (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array).
root_description: This AP computes a rolling volatility series from a returns array using a specified window and then resamples the volatility series to the requested period granularity.
root_description_as_composed: Given an array of returns and a window size, computes and returns an array of rolling realized volatility values over successive windows.

name: Time Series Line Chart Builder
description: Takes series (array), target_granularity (string) and metric (string) and produces chart (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 2: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 1 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Resamples a time series to a chosen period and produces a line chart specification for the selected metric.
root_description_as_composed: Converts an input time series array to a requested period granularity and outputs the resulting time series array.

name: Annotated Time-Series Line Chart
description: Takes series (array), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 1 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Builds a line chart from an ordered metric series and adds a short explanatory note with highlighting hints.
root_description_as_composed: Creates a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the plotted metric.

name: Rolling Volatility Chart
description: Takes returns (array), window (number), target_granularity (string) and metric (string) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 3: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 2 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Turns a returns series into a line chart specification by computing a moving volatility estimate, resampling it to a chosen period, and formatting it for plotting.
root_description_as_composed: Given an array of returns and a window size, computes and returns an array of rolling realized volatility values over successive windows.

name: Annotated Resampled Line Charts
description: Takes series (array), target_granularity (string), metric (string) and note (string) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). Step 2: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 1 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 3: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) from step 2 and note (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Resamples a time series to a chosen granularity, builds a line chart for the selected metric, and adds a short note with highlighting hints to the chart specification.
root_description_as_composed: Converts an input time series array to a requested period granularity and outputs the resulting time series array.

name: Medical Code Descent Expansion
description: Takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array), graph_schema (object) and base_code_set (array) and produces expanded_code_set (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array). Step 2: converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array). Step 3: expands a base medical code set to descendant codes using parent-child vocabulary triples. It returns the original codes and any reachable descendants, takes base_code_set (array) and vocabulary_triples (array) from step 2 as input and outputs expanded_code_set (array).
root_description: Derives schema-valid parent-child medical code relations from linked clinical text and returns a seed code set plus all reachable descendant codes.
root_description_as_composed: Given text chunks, linked entity pairs, and a graph schema, this AP produces candidate typed relation triples whose relation types and argument types fit the schema.

name: Image Query Passage Retrieval
description: Takes images (array), model (object) and query (string) and produces passages (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array). Step 2: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) from step 1 as input and outputs index (object). Step 3: retrieves text chunks from a search index using lexical BM25 scoring, takes query (string) and index (object) from step 2 as input and outputs passages (array).
root_description: Embeds each image in an image batch with a model, builds a nearest-neighbor visual index, and returns BM25-ranked text passages for the query.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an input batch using a supplied vision model and returns the embeddings as an array.

name: Image Similarity Retrieval Index
description: Takes images (array) and model (object) and produces index (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array). Step 2: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) from step 1 as input and outputs index (object).
root_description: Extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from a batch of images using a supplied model and assembles them into a nearest-neighbor lookup index for image similarity search.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an input batch using a supplied vision model and returns the embeddings as an array.

name: Image Similarity Passage Retrieval
description: Takes embeddings (array) and query (string) and produces passages (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a nearest-neighbor retrieval index from image embeddings so that images can be compared by visual similarity, takes embeddings (array) as input and outputs index (object). Step 2: retrieves text chunks from a search index using lexical BM25 scoring, takes query (string) and index (object) from step 1 as input and outputs passages (array).
root_description: Uses supplied image embeddings and a query string to return matching text passages.
root_description_as_composed: Builds a queryable nearest-neighbor index from arrays of image feature vectors so stored images can be retrieved by visual similarity.

name: Student Assessment Trend Summarizer
description: Takes report (string) and sql (string) and produces trend_summary (string) in 3 steps. Step 1: checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 1 as input and outputs result (array). Step 3: summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 2 as input and outputs trend_summary (string).
root_description: Checks a provenance report for required sources and transformations, runs the supplied SQL query safely, and summarizes the trend in a student's recent assessment results as improving, declining, or stable.
root_description_as_composed: Evaluates a provenance report and returns a boolean indicating whether required sources and transformations are listed.

name: Provenance-Gated SQL Results
description: Takes report (string) and sql (string) and produces result (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 1 as input and outputs result (array).
root_description: Checks a provenance report for required sources and transformations, and if compliant executes a provided SQL query to return the result rows.
root_description_as_composed: Evaluates a provenance report and returns a boolean indicating whether required sources and transformations are listed.

name: Student Attempt Trend Summary
description: Takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) and produces trend_summary (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array). Step 2: summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs trend_summary (string).
root_description: Executes a supplied SQL query against student assessment data and returns a plain-text description of whether recent student attempts are improving, declining, or stable.
root_description_as_composed: Takes an SQL query and a safety flag, runs the query against the input dataset, and returns the resulting rows.

name: Budget Actual Variance Report
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array), table_records (array) and mapping (object) and produces comparison (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs harmonized_records (array). Step 3: compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) from step 2 and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).
root_description: Uses the column mapping and comparison report to translate values, harmonizes budget and actual records, and produces a fiscal-period budget-to-actual variance comparison.
root_description_as_composed: It uses a column mapping and a domain comparison report to recommend value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible.

name: Harmonize Records to Target Schema
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array) and table_records (array) and produces harmonized_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs harmonized_records (array).
root_description: Given a column mapping, a domain comparison report, and raw table records, recommend compatible value translations and rewrite the records into target column names and values without changing row order.
root_description_as_composed: It uses a column mapping and a domain comparison report to recommend value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible.

name: Budget Actual Variance by Period
description: Takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object), value_mapping (object) and mapping (object) and produces comparison (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: renames columns and converts values in table rows so they conform to a target schema. It applies the supplied column and value mappings without changing the row order, takes table_records (array), column_mapping (object) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs harmonized_records (array). Step 2: compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) from step 1 and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).
root_description: The AP standardizes supplied budget and actual records according to mappings, then produces a per-fiscal-period report of absolute and percentage variance.
root_description_as_composed: Applies supplied column and value mappings to table rows, producing harmonized records in a target schema while preserving row order.

name: Occupation Survey Weight Plan
description: Takes column_mapping (object), comparison_report (array) and coded_occupation_records (array) and produces survey_weight_plan (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: recommends value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible. It uses the column mapping and the domain comparison report, takes column_mapping (object) and comparison_report (array) as input and outputs value_mapping (object). Step 2: builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and value_mapping (object) from step 1 as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).
root_description: Using a column mapping, comparison report, and coded records, reconciles occupation labels and creates a survey_weight_plan of per-response weights based on target occupation shares.
root_description_as_composed: It uses a column mapping and a domain comparison report to recommend value-level translations that make mapped columns compatible.

name: Safe Provenance Prediction Explanations
description: Takes report (string), sql (string), model (object) and feature_rows (array) and produces attributions (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: checks whether a provenance report lists required sources and transformations and returns a compliance flag, takes report (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 2: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) from step 1 as input and outputs result (array). Step 3: attributes the predicted class for each input row to the model feature columns and returns row-level attribution scores, takes model (object), predicted_rows (array) from step 2 and feature_rows (array) as input and outputs attributions (array).
root_description: Validates a provenance report, runs only the permitted SQL query, and returns per-row feature attributions for the model predictions.
root_description_as_composed: Evaluates a provenance report and returns a boolean indicating whether required sources and transformations are listed.

name: Model Explanations for SQL Rows
description: Takes sql (string), is_safe (boolean), model (object) and feature_rows (array) and produces attributions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) and is_safe (boolean) as input and outputs result (array). Step 2: attributes the predicted class for each input row to the model feature columns and returns row-level attribution scores, takes model (object), predicted_rows (array) from step 1 and feature_rows (array) as input and outputs attributions (array).
root_description: Executes an SQL query over the dataset and attributes each predicted class in the returned rows to the model's feature columns.
root_description_as_composed: Takes an SQL query and a safety flag, runs the query against the input dataset, and returns the resulting rows.

name: Multilingual citation support checker
description: Takes text (string), language_records (array), target_language (string), query (string) and citations (array) and produces supported (boolean) in 4 steps. Step 1: splits a long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks, takes text (string) as input and outputs chunks (array). Step 2: filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array) from step 1, language_records (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array). Step 3: generates an answer summary for a query from retrieved text chunks, takes query (string) and passages (array) from step 2 as input and outputs answer_summary (string). Step 4: checks whether the answer summary is supported by the cited passages for the query, takes query (string), answer_summary (string) from step 3 and citations (array) as input and outputs supported (boolean).
root_description: It splits a long plain-text document into ordered chunks, translates chunks not already in the target language, generates a summary answer to a query, and returns whether that summary is supported by the cited passages.
root_description_as_composed: Splits one long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks.

name: Topic Gap Study Plan Builder
description: Takes performance_profile (object), topic (string), material_limit (number) and questions (string) and produces study_plan (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: recommends study material entries as JSON for a student's topic gap based on performance profile. Returns material entries only, without answers or explanations, takes performance_profile (object), topic (string) and material_limit (number) as input and outputs materials (string). Step 2: builds a study-plan JSON that interleaves recommended material and recommended questions into a practice sequence. Returns the plan only, without execution instructions, takes performance_profile (object), materials (string) from step 1 and questions (string) as input and outputs study_plan (string).
root_description: Given a performance profile, topic, material limit, and question set, recommends matching study materials and combines them with the questions into a JSON study plan practice sequence.
root_description_as_composed: Recommends study material entries for a student's topic gap based on performance profile and returns only those entries as JSON without answers or explanations.

name: Dashboard Chart Collection Assembler
description: Takes comparison (object), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces chart_collection (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) as input and outputs chart (object). Step 2: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 1, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).
root_description: Converts a period comparison report into a baseline-versus-target chart specification and assembles it with two additional chart specifications into an ordered chart collection for dashboard use.
root_description_as_composed: Creates a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period in a period comparison report.

name: Image Caption Batch From Classifier
description: Takes rows (array), mapping (object) and images (array) and produces captions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: fits a classification model from feature rows and the target column identified in the column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs model (object). Step 2: generates a short natural-language caption for each image in an image batch. Returns one caption record per image in the same order, takes images (array) and model (object) from step 1 as input and outputs captions (array).
root_description: Fits a classifier from tabular rows and a target-column mapping, then generates one short natural-language caption for each supplied image in the original order.
root_description_as_composed: Fits a classification model from a set of feature rows, using the target column identified in the supplied column mapping, and returns the trained model.

name: Page Image Captioner
description: Takes page_images (array) and model (object) and produces captions (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: normalizes an ordered array of page images into a standard image batch with consistent size, orientation, and color format, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs images (array). Step 2: generates a short natural-language caption for each image in an image batch. Returns one caption record per image in the same order, takes images (array) from step 1 and model (object) as input and outputs captions (array).
root_description: Prepares an ordered batch of page images and generates one short caption per page using a selected vision model.
root_description_as_composed: Takes an ordered array of scanned page images and produces a standardized image batch with uniform dimensions, upright pages, and consistent color format.

name: Entity-Guided Relation Triple Extraction
description: Takes entity_records (array), graph_schema (object) and text_chunks (array) and produces relation_triples (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: links entity records to candidate graph nodes using a graph schema. Returns link records that include node candidates and confidence scores, takes entity_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs entity_link_records (array). Step 2: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array).

root_description: Converts document table layout blocks and OCR text chunks into table records and returns them after replacing direct identifiers according to a pseudonymisation plan.
root_description_as_composed: The AP takes layout_blocks, keeps the table blocks, and outputs bounding table_regions ready for cell extraction.

name: Dataset Card Composer

Step 1: profiles a table row array into a dataset profile with row counts, per-column null rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges. name: Chart Answer Annotation Highlighter
description: Takes query (string), passages (array) and chart (object) and produces chart (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: generates an answer summary for a query from retrieved text chunks, takes query (string) and passages (array) as input and outputs answer_summary (string). Step 2: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) and note (string) from step 1 as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Builds an answer summary from a query and retrieved passages and adds that note plus highlight hints to an existing chart.
root_description_as_composed: Generates a concise answer summary for a query by synthesizing retrieved text passages.

name: ISCO Occupation Coding

name: Resampled Percentage Return Series

Step 1: converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array).
root_description: Computes period-over-period percentage returns from a level time series and resamples the return series to the target granularity.
root_description_as_composed: Transforms a level time-series array into a time-series array of period-over-period percentage returns at the specified granularity.

name: Pseudonymised Re-identification Risk Score
description: Takes records (array), quasi_report (array), k_report (object) and l_report (object) and produces score (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) as input and outputs groups (array). Step 2: combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) and groups (array) from step 1 as input and outputs score (number).
root_description: Combines pseudonymised records, quasi-identifier definitions, and k/l privacy reports into a single re-identification risk score.
root_description_as_composed: From a records array and a quasi_report array, it outputs groups containing pseudonymised records with identical quasi-identifier patterns.

name: Seasonally Adjusted Trend Returns
description: Takes series (array), season_length (number), target_granularity (string) and granularity (string) and produces returns (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: decomposes a time series into a trend component and a seasonal profile for a fixed seasonal period, takes series (array) and season_length (number) as input and outputs trend (array) and seasonality (object). Step 2: resamples a time series to a target period granularity and returns a new time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and target_granularity (string) as input and outputs resampled (array). root_description_as_composed: Splits a fixed-period time series into a long-term trend array and a repeating seasonal profile object.

name: Resampled Percent Returns

root_description: Creates occupation-adjusted survey records and returns a cross-tabulation table with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages.

name: Occupational Survey Record Weighting

The threshold value controls the width of the intervals, takes model (object), new_rows (array) from step 2 and alpha (number) as input and outputs predictions (array).

Step 3: aligns source and translated text chunks by length, order, and content cues, returning segment pairs with confidence scores, takes source_chunks (array) from step 1, translated_chunks (array) from step 2 and align_threshold (number) as input and outputs segment_alignment (array). Step 4: reviews segment alignments against a quality threshold and returns a validation report plus the alignments that pass, takes translated_chunks (array) from step 2, segment_alignment (array) from step 3 and accept_threshold (number) as input and outputs validation_report (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array).
root_description: The AP splits a plain-text document into ordered chunks, cleans translated chunks against the source, aligns source and translated segments using length, order, and content cues, filters alignments by an acceptance threshold, and returns a validation report with only the accepted alignments.
