name: Time Series Forecast Accuracy
description: Takes series (array) and horizon (number) and produces accuracy (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: forecasts the next requested number of observations from a time series, takes series (array) and horizon (number) as input and outputs forecast (array). Step 2: scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) and forecast (array) from step 1 as input and outputs accuracy (number).
root_description: Forecasts a requested number of future observations from a numeric time series and returns a single accuracy score for that forecast.
root_description_as_composed: Given a time series array and a horizon number, the AP generates the requested number of future observations as a forecast array.

name: Top-K Image Similarity Ranking
description: Takes images (array), model (object), index (object) and top_k (number) and produces rankings (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array). Step 2: returns the closest indexed image embeddings for each query embedding, limited to the requested top-k count, takes query_embeddings (array) from step 1, index (object) and top_k (number) as input and outputs rankings (array).
root_description: Given a batch of query images, a visual model, an indexed image collection, and a top_k value, it converts the query images to visual embeddings and returns the closest matching indexed images for each query up to top_k.
root_description_as_composed: Extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an input batch using a supplied vision model and returns the embeddings as an array.

name: Annotated Dashboard Chart Collection
description: Takes rows (array), chart (object), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) and produces chart_collection (array) in 4 steps. Step 1: profiles a table row array into a dataset profile with row counts, per-column null rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges. Returns only the profile, takes rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object). Step 2: composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) from step 1 as input and outputs summary (string). Step 3: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) and note (string) from step 2 as input and outputs chart (object). Step 4: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object) from step 3, chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array).
root_description: Profiles a table row array, turns the profile into a short dataset card, uses that card to annotate the first chart, and returns an ordered three-chart dashboard collection.
root_description_as_composed: Profiles an array of table rows into a dataset profile with record count, per-column missing rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges.

name: Dataset Card Chart Annotation
description: Takes rows (array) and chart (object) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: profiles a table row array into a dataset profile with row counts, per-column null rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges. Returns only the profile, takes rows (array) as input and outputs profile (object). Step 2: composes a plain-text dataset card from a dataset profile. It explains the dataset size, key columns, and profile coverage in short sentences, takes profile (object) from step 1 as input and outputs summary (string). Step 3: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) and note (string) from step 2 as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Profiles raw row arrays into a compact dataset card and adds that note plus highlighting hints to an existing chart specification.
root_description_as_composed: Profiles an array of table rows into a dataset profile with record count, per-column missing rates, unique counts, inferred types, and numeric ranges.

name: Safe SQL Query Execution
description: Takes query (string) and schema (string) and produces result (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: rewrites an SQL query for better performance using the database schema and returns the optimized query, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: checks whether an SQL query references only tables and columns present in the schema and returns a safety flag, takes query (string) from step 1 and schema (string) as input and outputs flag (boolean). Step 3: executes an SQL query against the input dataset and returns the result rows, takes sql (string) from step 1 and is_safe (boolean) from step 2 as input and outputs result (array).
root_description: Rewrites a supplied SQL query using its schema, checks that the query is safe to run, and executes it to return the matching result rows.
root_description_as_composed: Rewrites a supplied SQL query, using its database schema, into a faster query that should return the same results.

name: Nearest Polygon Point Matching
description: Takes points (array) and polygons (array) and produces matches (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: assigns point geometries to containing polygons and returns polygons with joined point attributes, takes points (array) and polygons (array) as input and outputs polygons (array). Step 2: assigns each point geometry to its closest polygon and returns point-to-polygon matches, takes points (array) and polygons (array) from step 1 as input and outputs matches (array).
root_description: Assigns supplied points to containing polygons and then produces a match list linking every point to its nearest polygon feature.
root_description_as_composed: Assigns each point to the polygon that contains it and returns the polygons with the matched point attributes joined.

name: Occupational Translation Chunk Cleanup
description: Takes text_chunks (array) and translated_chunks (array) and produces cleaned_translated_chunks (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations. It preserves chunk and response identifiers, takes text_chunks (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array). Step 2: cleans translated chunks by normalizing whitespace, preserving placeholders, and repairing formatting with reference to the original source chunks, takes translated_chunks (array) and source_chunks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs cleaned_translated_chunks (array).
root_description: Cleans occupational text chunks and uses the cleaned source to repair translated occupational chunks, returning cleaned_translated_chunks.
root_description_as_composed: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations while preserving chunk and response identifiers.

name: Graph Expanded Patient Code Filter
description: Takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array), graph_schema (object), base_code_set (array) and coded_patient_records (array) and produces coded_patient_records (array) in 4 steps. Step 1: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array). Step 2: converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array). Step 3: expands a base medical code set to descendant codes using parent-child vocabulary triples. It returns the original codes and any reachable descendants, takes base_code_set (array) and vocabulary_triples (array) from step 2 as input and outputs expanded_code_set (array). Step 4: keeps coded patient records containing at least one diagnosis code in the target medical code set. Records with no matching code are removed, takes coded_patient_records (array) and target_code_set (array) from step 3 as input and outputs coded_patient_records (array).
root_description: Extract schema-guided relation triples from linked text entities, expand a base medical code set through the resulting parent-child triples, and return coded patient records containing a diagnosis in the expanded set.
root_description_as_composed: Given text chunks, linked entity pairs, and a graph schema, this AP produces candidate typed relation triples whose relation types and argument types fit the schema.

name: Natural Language Weather Graph Readings
description: Takes natural_language_query (string), graph_schema (object), graph_triples (array) and variable_name (string) and produces readings (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: translates a natural-language graph question into an executable graph query plan. The graph schema is used to resolve query entities, relation names, and property paths, takes natural_language_query (string) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_query_plan (object). Step 2: runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) from step 1 and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 3: converts generic result rows into normalized weather reading records for one measured variable, takes rows (array) from step 2 and variable_name (string) as input and outputs readings (array).
root_description: Given a natural-language graph question, schema, triples, and variable name, it generates a query, executes it over the triples, and returns normalized weather reading records.
root_description_as_composed: It turns a natural-language graph question and schema into an executable graph query plan.

name: Harmonized Survey Response Extract
description: Takes left_table_records (array), right_table_records (array) and column_mapping (object) and produces survey_response_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: recommends left and right join keys that can align two harmonized table datasets. It evaluates key uniqueness and value overlap between the tables, takes left_table_records (array) and right_table_records (array) as input and outputs join_key_spec (object). Step 2: joins two table datasets using a join key specification and returns the combined rows. It keeps source table markers to distinguish the two sides, takes left_table_records (array), right_table_records (array) and join_key_spec (object) from step 1 as input and outputs joined_records (array). Step 3: extracts survey response rows from table records and keeps only the columns named in the mapping. Rows without a response identifier are excluded, takes table_records (array) from step 2 and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_response_records (array).
root_description: Recommends keys to align two harmonized table datasets, combines them, and extracts survey response records containing only mapped columns, excluding rows without a response identifier.
root_description_as_composed: This AP takes two harmonized table record arrays and returns a recommended left and right key specification for aligning them.

name: Survey Response Join Extractor
description: Takes left_table_records (array), right_table_records (array), join_key_spec (object) and column_mapping (object) and produces survey_response_records (array) in 2 steps. root_description_as_composed: Combines two table datasets into matched records according to a key rule, while preserving markers that identify the source side of each row.

It returns weighted survey records without changing the underlying response values, takes coded_occupation_records (array) from step 1 and survey_weight_plan (object) as input and outputs weighted_survey_records (array).

root_description_as_composed: Selects the highest-confidence occupation candidate above a threshold for each survey response and returns the response fields with the assigned ISCO code.

name: Pseudonymised Table Risk Score
description: Takes records (array), k_report (object) and l_report (object) and produces score (number) in 4 steps. Step 1: detects direct personal-data fields in table records and returns a row-level detection report. It reports fields such as names, government identifiers, contact details, and addresses, takes records (array) as input and outputs report (array). Step 2: identifies quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely identify records after direct personal data is removed. It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs report (array). Step 3: groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) from step 2 as input and outputs groups (array). Step 4: combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) and groups (array) from step 3 as input and outputs score (number).
root_description: Detects direct personal fields and quasi-identifier combinations, groups equivalence classes, and returns a single re-identification risk score.
root_description_as_composed: Inspects table records and outputs a row-level report identifying direct personal-data fields such as names, identifiers, contacts, and addresses.

It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs report (array).

It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs report (array). Step 3: groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) from step 2 as input and outputs groups (array).

root_description_as_composed: Inspects table records and outputs a row-level report identifying direct personal-data fields such as names, identifiers, contacts, and addresses.

name: Pseudonymised Dataset Re-identification Risk Score
description: Takes records (array), personal_report (array), k_report (object) and l_report (object) and produces score (number) in 3 steps. Step 1: identifies quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely identify records after direct personal data is removed. It uses the personal-data report to avoid treating direct identifiers as quasi-identifiers, takes records (array) and personal_report (array) as input and outputs report (array). Step 2: groups pseudonymised records into equivalence classes by their quasi-identifier values. Each group contains the member records that share the same quasi-identifier pattern, takes records (array) and quasi_report (array) from step 1 as input and outputs groups (array). Step 3: combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and equivalence-class size evidence into one re-identification risk score. Higher values indicate a greater chance of linking a pseudonymised record to an external dataset, takes k_report (object), l_report (object) and groups (array) from step 2 as input and outputs score (number).
root_description: It examines records that have had direct personal details removed, groups records sharing the same quasi-identifier pattern, and combines k-anonymity, l-diversity, and group-size evidence into one numeric re-identification risk score.
root_description_as_composed: Uses a records array and a personal-data report to identify remaining quasi-identifier columns and combinations that could uniquely single out records after direct personal data is removed.

name: Weighted Occupation Crosstab First Rows
description: Takes coded_occupation_records (array), value_mapping (object), column_mapping (object) and limit (number) and produces rows (array) in 4 steps. Step 1: builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object). Step 2: applies the weight plan to coded response records and adds a numeric weight field to each output record. It returns weighted survey records without changing the underlying response values, takes coded_occupation_records (array) and survey_weight_plan (object) from step 1 as input and outputs weighted_survey_records (array). Step 3: builds a cross-tabulation table from weighted survey records using the row and column variables named in the column mapping. It returns result rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages, takes weighted_survey_records (array) from step 2 and column_mapping (object) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 4: returns the first rows of a result-row array, using the input limit to choose how many rows to keep, takes rows (array) from step 3 and limit (number) as input and outputs rows (array).
root_description: Creates occupation-specific survey weights from coded responses and benchmark shares, applies them, cross-tabulates mapped variables, and returns the first limited rows with unweighted counts, weighted counts, and percentages.
root_description_as_composed: Creates per-response survey weights from coded occupation records and occupation group mappings so the observed occupation mix matches target population shares.

name: Learner Result Trend Summary

Step 3: summarizes the trend in a student's result rows over recent attempts, such as improving, declining, or stable. Returns a plain-text trend description, takes assessment_rows (array) from step 2 as input and outputs trend_summary (string).
root_description: Joins two assessment datasets, applies a supplied classifier to the combined rows, and summarizes a student's recent predicted result trend as plain text.

name: Schema Match Categorical Encoder

It uses table names, column names, and inferred types, takes source_schema (string) and target_schema (string) as input and outputs mapping (object). name: Rolling Realized Volatility From Series

Step 1: converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array). Step 2: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) from step 1 and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array).
root_description: Transforms a level time series into rolling volatility by computing period-over-period percentage returns at the chosen granularity and applying a rolling window to those returns.
root_description_as_composed: Transforms a level time-series array into a time-series array of period-over-period percentage returns at the specified granularity.

name: Page Image Embedding Extraction
description: Takes page_images (array) and model (object) and produces embeddings (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: normalizes an ordered array of page images into a standard image batch with consistent size, orientation, and color format, takes page_images (array) as input and outputs images (array). Step 2: extracts fixed-length visual embeddings from each image in an image batch, takes images (array) from step 1 and model (object) as input and outputs embeddings (array).
root_description: Normalizes an ordered array of page images into a consistent image batch and uses a model to extract fixed-length visual embeddings for each page.
root_description_as_composed: Takes an ordered array of scanned page images and produces a standardized image batch with uniform dimensions, upright pages, and consistent color format.

name: Categorical Encoding Descriptive Stats

Step 1: converts selected categorical feature columns in table rows into binary indicator columns and removes the original categorical columns, takes rows (array) and features (object) as input and outputs encoded_rows (array). Step 2: computes mean, variance, skewness, and kurtosis for selected numeric columns in table rows. Also computes the same summaries within each group defined by the column mapping, takes rows (array) from step 1 and mapping (object) as input and outputs overall (object) and grouped (array).
root_description: Encodes selected categorical columns into binary indicator columns, then computes overall and mapping-grouped mean, variance, skewness, and kurtosis for numeric columns.

name: Seasonally Adjusted Return Volatility Chart

Step 1: computes rolling realized volatility from a return series using the supplied rolling window size. It returns a time series of volatility values, takes returns (array) and window (number) as input and outputs volatility (array). Step 2: estimates seasonal patterns in an economic indicator time series for the supplied seasonal period length. It returns a seasonality profile describing seasonal indices by period, takes series (array) from step 1 and period_length (number) as input and outputs profile (object). Step 3: removes seasonal effects from an economic indicator time series using a seasonality profile. It returns a seasonally adjusted time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and profile (object) from step 2 as input and outputs adjusted_series (array). Step 4: builds a line chart specification from an ordered time series and the name of the metric being plotted, takes series (array) from step 3 and metric (string) as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Creates a line chart of rolling return volatility after estimating and removing a seasonal profile from the volatility series.

name: Seasonal Volatility Profile

It returns a seasonality profile describing seasonal indices by period, takes series (array) from step 1 and period_length (number) as input and outputs profile (object).

name: Weighted Survey Occupation Aggregates
description: Takes coded_occupation_records (array), survey_weight_plan (object), column_mapping (object), variable_name (string), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) and produces summary (array) in 4 steps. name: Query Index Sentiment Label
description: Takes query (string) and index (object) and produces score (number) and label (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: retrieves text chunks from a search index using dense vector similarity, takes query (string) and index (object) as input and outputs passages (array). Step 2: computes polarity and a coarse sentiment label for the combined text represented by the chunks, takes chunks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs score (number) and label (string).
root_description: Retrieves index passages for a query and returns a polarity score and coarse sentiment label for their combined text.
root_description_as_composed: Searches an existing text index with a natural-language query and returns the most similar text chunks.

name: Dataset Question Keyword Expansion
description: Takes original_query (string) and produces keywords (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: expands an information-retrieval query with synonyms, abbreviations, and related terms, takes original_query (string) as input and outputs expanded_query (string). Step 2: translates a natural-language dataset question into keyword records for catalogue search. It expands each requested topic into searchable terms and facets, takes question (string) from step 1 as input and outputs keywords (array).
root_description: Expands a raw dataset question with synonyms and related terms, then converts it into searchable keyword records and facets for catalogue discovery.
root_description_as_composed: Expands a given information-retrieval query string into a broader query string containing synonyms, abbreviations, and related terms.

name: Missing Value Rule Violations
description: Takes rows (array), features (object) and rules (object) and produces report (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: fills missing values in selected feature columns of table rows using a mean for numeric columns and a mode for categorical columns, takes rows (array) and features (object) as input and outputs filled_rows (array). Step 2: validates table rows against a validation rule specification and returns row-level violations. Returns only violations, without modifying the rows, takes rows (array) from step 1 and rules (object) as input and outputs report (array).
root_description: It fills missing values in selected feature columns and returns row-level validation violations for the completed rows.
root_description_as_composed: Imputes missing values in selected numeric columns with their column mean and selected categorical columns with their column mode, returning completed table rows.

name: Economic Indicator Forecasting
description: Takes rows (array), mapping (object) and horizon (number) and produces forecast (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds an ordered economic indicator or price time series from table rows. It uses the date and value columns named in the column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs series (array). Step 2: forecasts the next requested number of observations from a time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and horizon (number) as input and outputs forecast (array).
root_description: Converts mapped table rows into an ordered economic indicator or price series and returns a requested number of future values.
root_description_as_composed: Builds an ordered date-value series from table rows by sorting rows on the mapped date column and pairing each date with its mapped value.

name: Occupation Coding for Survey Text
description: Takes text_chunks (array), occupation_code_set (array), survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) and produces coded_occupation_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations. It preserves chunk and response identifiers, takes text_chunks (array) as input and outputs text_chunks (array). Step 2: matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array). Step 3: assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array) from step 2, survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array).
root_description: The AP cleans free-text occupational answers, matches them to ISCO candidates with confidence scores, and returns each survey response with its highest-confidence occupation code above a threshold.
root_description_as_composed: Cleans occupational text chunks by normalizing case, whitespace, punctuation, and common abbreviations while preserving chunk and response identifiers.

name: Correlation Significance For Rows

Step 1: computes a Pearson correlation matrix for selected numeric columns in table rows using the supplied column mapping, takes rows (array) and mapping (object) as input and outputs correlations (object). Step 2: tests whether correlations in a correlation matrix are statistically significant at the supplied threshold. Returns a hypothesis test result with pair-level p-values and decisions, takes correlations (object) from step 1 and alpha (number) as input and outputs test_result (object).
root_description: Computes Pearson correlations for mapped numeric fields and reports pair-level p-values and significance decisions at the supplied alpha.
root_description_as_composed: Computes pairwise Pearson correlations among selected numeric columns from table rows and a column mapping.

name: Weather Period Comparison Chart
description: Takes readings (array), period_granularity (string), summary_metric (string) and target_summary (array) and produces chart (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: groups weather readings by time period and computes the chosen summary metric, takes readings (array), period_granularity (string) and summary_metric (string) as input and outputs summary (array). Step 2: compares baseline and target period summaries and returns period-by-period differences, takes baseline_summary (array) from step 1 and target_summary (array) as input and outputs report (object). Step 3: turns a period comparison report into a chart specification that contrasts baseline and target values for each period, takes comparison (object) from step 2 as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: Groups weather readings by time period, computes a chosen summary metric, compares those period values with target period values, and produces a chart specification.
root_description_as_composed: Summarizes weather readings into values for chosen time periods such as daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly aggregates.

name: Budget Actual Period Variance Report
description: Takes dataset (object), row_limit (number) and mapping (object) and produces comparison (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: materializes a bounded row sample from a dataset for profiling. It uses the supplied threshold as the maximum number of rows to return, takes dataset (object) and row_limit (number) as input and outputs sample_rows (array). Step 2: compares budgeted and actual amount columns by fiscal period and computes absolute and percentage variance for each period. It returns a period comparison report, takes records (array) from step 1 and mapping (object) as input and outputs comparison (object).
root_description: Takes a dataset and row cap, samples bounded rows, and produces a fiscal-period comparison of budgeted and actual amounts with absolute and percentage variances.
root_description_as_composed: Reads a dataset and returns at most the allowed number of rows as a sample array for quick profiling.

name: Point Polygon Area Map Layer
description: Takes points (array), polygons (array) and area_metrics (array) and produces layer (object) in 2 steps. Step 1: assigns point geometries to containing polygons and returns polygons with joined point attributes, takes points (array) and polygons (array) as input and outputs polygons (array). Step 2: builds a vector map layer specification from polygons and their area metrics, takes polygons (array) from step 1 and area_metrics (array) as input and outputs layer (object).
root_description: This AP assigns points to the polygons that contain them and produces a vector map layer specification built from those polygons and their area metrics.
root_description_as_composed: Assigns each point to the polygon that contains it and returns the polygons with the matched point attributes joined.

name: Entity Type Candidate Linking
description: Takes entities (array), entity_type (string) and graph_schema (object) and produces entity_link_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: keeps only extracted entity records whose entity type matches the requested type, takes entities (array) and entity_type (string) as input and outputs filtered_entities (array). Step 2: links entity records to candidate graph nodes using a graph schema. Returns link records that include node candidates and confidence scores, takes entity_records (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs entity_link_records (array).
root_description: Filters supplied extracted entities to the requested type and returns candidate graph-node links with confidence scores.
root_description_as_composed: Takes extracted entity records and a requested type, then returns only the records matching that type.

name: Missing Text Cell Report
description: Takes dataset (object) and rows (array) and produces report (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: builds a metadata profile for a dataset from its catalogue entry. It records available column names, column types, row counts, and provenance fields, takes dataset (object) as input and outputs profile (object). Step 2: flags null, empty, whitespace, and placeholder cells in table rows, using the profile to identify likely text columns. Returns a missing-value report, takes rows (array) and profile (object) from step 1 as input and outputs report (array).
root_description: Builds a metadata profile from a dataset catalogue entry and scans supplied rows to report missing, blank, whitespace-only, or placeholder text cells.
root_description_as_composed: Summarises a dataset from its catalogue entry into a profile containing column names, column types, row count, and provenance information.

name: Filter Chunks for Translation
description: Takes chunks (array) and target_language (string) and produces chunks_to_translate (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: detects the written language of each text chunk. Returns language identification records with language codes and confidence scores, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs language_records (array). Step 2: filters text chunks down to those requiring translation by keeping chunks whose detected language differs from the target language code, takes chunks (array), language_records (array) from step 1 and target_language (string) as input and outputs chunks_to_translate (array).
root_description: Filters an array of text chunks down to only the chunks that are not already written in the target language.
root_description_as_composed: Detects the written language of each text chunk and returns language records containing language codes and confidence scores.

name: Schema-Aware Graph Triple Builder
description: Takes entity_records (array), graph_schema (object) and text_chunks (array) and produces graph_triples (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: links entity records to candidate graph nodes using a graph schema. Returns link records that include node candidates and confidence scores, takes entity_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs entity_link_records (array). Step 2: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array). Step 3: converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) from step 2 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array).
root_description: Links supplied entity records to schema-defined nodes, infers relation candidates from text chunks, and validates them into schema-conforming graph triples.
root_description_as_composed: Matches input entity records to candidate graph nodes according to a supplied graph schema and returns candidate links with confidence scores.

name: SQL Result Row Summary
description: Takes query (string), schema (string) and rows (array) and produces summary (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: rewrites an SQL query for better performance using the database schema and returns the optimized query, takes query (string) and schema (string) as input and outputs query (string). Step 2: summarises a result-row array in plain language using the originating SQL query as context and returns a result summary, takes rows (array) and query (string) from step 1 as input and outputs summary (string).
root_description: Rewrites an SQL query against a schema for performance, then explains the returned result rows in plain language.
root_description_as_composed: Rewrites a supplied SQL query, using its database schema, into a faster query that should return the same results.

name: Seasonal Forecast Accuracy Score
description: Takes series (array), season_length (number) and forecast (array) and produces accuracy (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: decomposes a time series into a trend component and a seasonal profile for a fixed seasonal period, takes series (array) and season_length (number) as input and outputs trend (array) and seasonality (object). Step 2: scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and forecast (array) as input and outputs accuracy (number).
root_description: Computes a single accuracy score for a forecast from an observed seasonal time series and its fixed seasonal length.
root_description_as_composed: Splits a fixed-period time series into a long-term trend array and a repeating seasonal profile object.

name: Filtered Chart Dashboard Assembler
description: Takes chart_1 (object), chart_2 (object), chart_3 (object) and mapping (object) and produces dashboard (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: collects individual chart specifications into an ordered collection for dashboard assembly, takes chart_1 (object), chart_2 (object) and chart_3 (object) as input and outputs chart_collection (array). Step 2: arranges a chart collection into a dashboard specification with panels and titles, takes chart_collection (array) from step 1 as input and outputs dashboard (object). Step 3: adds interactive filter controls to a dashboard by mapping selectable display fields to source table columns, takes dashboard (object) from step 2 and mapping (object) as input and outputs dashboard (object).
root_description: Assembles three chart specifications into an ordered titled multi-panel dashboard and adds interactive filter controls mapped to source table columns.
root_description_as_composed: Collects three chart specifications into an ordered chart collection for dashboard assembly.

name: Graph Query Entity Enrichment
description: Takes graph_query_plan (object), graph_triples (array) and entity_link_records (array) and produces enriched_entity_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: runs a graph query plan over graph triples and returns matching result rows. It returns only query results, without adding or removing graph triples, takes graph_query_plan (object) and graph_triples (array) as input and outputs result_rows (array). Step 2: joins query result rows to entity link records to add graph-derived fields to each entity record. Returns enriched entity records without changing unrelated fields, takes entity_link_records (array) and result_rows (array) from step 1 as input and outputs enriched_entity_records (array).
root_description: Runs a supplied graph query over triples and joins the returned rows into entity link records to produce enriched entity records.
root_description_as_composed: Executes a supplied graph query plan against graph triples and returns the matching result rows.

name: Translated Chunk Reassembly and Resegmentation
description: Takes chunks (array), target_language (string), source_chunks (array), accepted_segment_alignment (array) and max_chunk_size (number) and produces chunks (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: translates each source text chunk into the requested target language, takes chunks (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs translated_chunks (array). Step 2: reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) from step 1 and accepted_segment_alignment (array) as input and outputs translated_text (string). Step 3: splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) from step 2 and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array).
root_description: Translates aligned source segments into a target language, reconstructs the complete translated text with source-text fallback, and re-splits the result into chunks.
root_description_as_composed: Translates each input text chunk into the requested target language and returns the translated chunks as an array.

name: Full Reconstructed Translation From Alignments
description: Takes chunks (array), target_language (string), source_chunks (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array) and produces translated_text (string) in 2 steps. Step 1: translates each source text chunk into the requested target language, takes chunks (array) and target_language (string) as input and outputs translated_chunks (array). Step 2: reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) from step 1 and accepted_segment_alignment (array) as input and outputs translated_text (string).
root_description: This AP translates source chunks into the requested language and reassembles accepted aligned translations into a full translated text, with source chunks as fallback for unaligned content.
root_description_as_composed: Translates each input text chunk into the requested target language and returns the translated chunks as an array.

name: Translated Segment Rechunker

Step 1: reassembles accepted aligned translated chunks into a full translated text, using original source chunks as fallback for unaligned content, takes source_chunks (array), translated_chunks (array) and accepted_segment_alignment (array) as input and outputs translated_text (string). Step 2: splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) from step 1 and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array).
root_description: Rebuilds a translated text from accepted aligned segments and source fallbacks, returning a size-limited list of translatable chunks.
root_description_as_composed: Combines editor-approved translated chunks into one full translated text, substituting original source chunks where no approved translation is matched.

name: Annotated Chart From Chunks

Step 1: summarizes an array of text chunks into a shorter plain-text summary, takes chunks (array) as input and outputs summary (string). Step 2: adds a short text annotation and highlighting hints to an existing chart specification, takes chart (object) and note (string) from step 1 as input and outputs chart (object).
root_description: The AP summarizes text chunks into a note and adds that note plus highlighting hints to an existing chart specification.
root_description_as_composed: Takes an array of text chunks and produces one shorter plain-text summary.

name: Document Entity Context Extractor

Step 1: splits a long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks, takes text (string) as input and outputs chunks (array). Step 2: extracts named entities and their context from an array of text chunks, takes chunks (array) from step 1 as input and outputs entities (array).
root_description: Turns a long plain-text document into a list of named entities and the context around each.
root_description_as_composed: Splits one long plain-text document into an ordered array of text chunks.

name: Occupation Based Survey Weight Plan
description: Takes query (string), candidate_passages (array), occupation_code_set (array), survey_response_records (array), threshold_value (number) and value_mapping (object) and produces survey_weight_plan (object) in 4 steps. Step 1: reranks candidate text chunks by relevance to the query, takes query (string) and candidate_passages (array) as input and outputs passages (array). Step 2: matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array). It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array) from step 2, survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array). Step 4: builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) from step 3 and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).
root_description: Reranks candidate occupational text for a query, selects threshold-passing ISCO codes for survey responses, and creates per-response post-stratification weights from target population shares.
root_description_as_composed: Reorders candidate text chunks by their relevance to a supplied query and returns the ordered passages.

name: Occupational Query ISCO Coding

It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array).
root_description: Selects query-relevant occupational text chunks from supplied passages and assigns candidate ISCO codes with confidence scores.
root_description_as_composed: Reorders candidate text chunks by their relevance to a supplied query and returns the ordered passages.

name: Threshold-Based Survey Occupation Coding

Step 1: matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array). Step 2: assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array) from step 1, survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array).
root_description: Selects one threshold-accepted ISCO occupation code for each survey response by choosing the highest-confidence candidate text match and preserving the original response fields.
root_description_as_composed: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns occupation coding records with candidate occupation codes and confidence scores.

name: Survey Response ISCO Coding
description: Takes query (string), candidate_passages (array), occupation_code_set (array), survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) and produces coded_occupation_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: reranks candidate text chunks by relevance to the query, takes query (string) and candidate_passages (array) as input and outputs passages (array). Step 2: matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array). Step 3: assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array) from step 2, survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array).
root_description: Reranks occupation reference passages against a survey query, matches cleaned text chunks to ISCO codes with confidence, and returns survey responses with one threshold-accepted code each.

name: Occupation Text Survey Weights
description: Takes text_chunks (array), occupation_code_set (array), survey_response_records (array), threshold_value (number) and value_mapping (object) and produces survey_weight_plan (object) in 3 steps. Step 1: matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns candidate occupation codes with confidence scores. It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array). Step 2: assigns one ISCO code to each survey response by selecting the highest confidence candidate that meets the threshold. It returns coded response records with the original response fields and the selected occupation code, takes occupation_coding_records (array) from step 1, survey_response_records (array) and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs coded_occupation_records (array). Step 3: builds a post-stratification weight plan by comparing observed occupation group frequencies in coded response records with target population shares. It returns per-response weights as a mapping, takes coded_occupation_records (array) from step 2 and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs survey_weight_plan (object).
root_description: It converts free-text occupational responses into coded survey records and produces per-response survey weights calibrated to target occupation shares.
root_description_as_composed: Matches cleaned occupational text chunks against an ISCO code set and returns occupation coding records with candidate occupation codes and confidence scores.

name: Bilingual Segment Alignment With Confidence
description: Takes text (string), max_chunk_size (number), translated_chunks (array) and align_threshold (number) and produces segment_alignment (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array). Step 2: aligns source and translated text chunks by length, order, and content cues, returning segment pairs with confidence scores, takes source_chunks (array) from step 1, translated_chunks (array) and align_threshold (number) as input and outputs segment_alignment (array).
root_description: Splits a source text into bounded chunks and aligns them with translated chunks to return confidence-scored segment pairs.

name: Schema-Validated Relation Triples
description: Takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) and produces graph_triples (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: extracts typed relation candidates from text chunks for pairs of linked entities. The graph schema guides relation classes and expected argument types, takes text_chunks (array), entity_link_records (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs relation_triples (array). Step 2: converts relation candidates into graph triples that conform to the graph schema. Invalid relation classes or mismatched entity types are dropped, takes relation_triples (array) from step 1 and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs graph_triples (array).
root_description: The AP extracts schema-guided relation candidates from text chunks using linked entities and then converts only the valid candidates into schema-conforming graph triples.
root_description_as_composed: Given text chunks, linked entity pairs, and a graph schema, this AP produces candidate typed relation triples whose relation types and argument types fit the schema.

name: Abrupt Return Change Finder
description: Takes series (array), granularity (string) and threshold (number) and produces change_points (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array). Step 2: detects abrupt level or trend changes in a time series using a sensitivity threshold, takes series (array) from step 1 and threshold (number) as input and outputs change_points (array).

name: Nearest Polygon Address Matching

Step 1: converts a list of textual addresses into point geometries, takes address_list (array) as input and outputs points (array). Step 2: assigns each point geometry to its closest polygon and returns point-to-polygon matches, takes points (array) from step 1 and polygons (array) as input and outputs matches (array).

name: Occupational Text to ISCO Coding
description: Takes text (string), max_chunk_size (number) and occupation_code_set (array) and produces occupation_coding_records (array) in 2 steps. Step 1: splits a plain-text document into translatable chunks using the maximum chunk size threshold, takes text (string) and max_chunk_size (number) as input and outputs chunks (array). It may return multiple candidates for each text chunk, takes text_chunks (array) from step 1 and occupation_code_set (array) as input and outputs occupation_coding_records (array).
root_description: Splits a plain-text document into bounded text segments and returns candidate ISCO occupation codes with confidence scores for each segment.

name: Cross-Source Entity Graph Linking
description: Takes left_entities (array), right_entities (array), value_mapping (object), threshold_value (number), graph_triples (array) and graph_schema (object) and produces node_link_records (array) in 3 steps. Step 1: generates candidate cross-source matches between two entity record sets using mapped attributes. It returns candidate pairs before clustering, takes left_entities (array), right_entities (array) and value_mapping (object) as input and outputs candidate_pairs (array). Step 2: groups candidate entity matches into clusters that represent the same real-world entity. It uses the supplied threshold to avoid chaining weak matches together, takes candidate_pairs (array) from step 1 and threshold_value (number) as input and outputs entity_groups (array). Step 3: links resolved entity record groups to existing graph nodes by matching cluster attributes to node properties in the triples. Returns node link records that map cluster identifiers to node identifiers, takes entity_record_groups (array) from step 2, graph_triples (array) and graph_schema (object) as input and outputs node_link_records (array).
root_description: This AP matches records from two sources using supplied attribute mappings, groups records that represent the same real-world entity above a threshold, and returns node link records that connect each accepted group to existing graph nodes.
root_description_as_composed: Generates possible cross-source record pairs from two entity lists using mapped attributes, returning candidate matches before clustering.

name: Forecast Accuracy From Level Data
description: Takes series (array), granularity (string) and forecast (array) and produces accuracy (number) in 2 steps. Step 1: converts a level series into period-over-period percentage returns using the supplied period granularity. It returns a time series of returns, takes series (array) and granularity (string) as input and outputs returns (array). Step 2: scores a forecast series against the observed tail of an actual time series, takes series (array) from step 1 and forecast (array) as input and outputs accuracy (number).

Step 2: builds survival records from coded patient records by extracting patient identifier, follow-up time, and event indicator columns named in the column mapping. name: Coded Patient Survival Record Builder
